name: CISA AA22-138B VMWare Workspace (Alt)
desc: Alternative method used to exploit VMWare Workspace ONE Access

acts.d: attackers used a Bash script to exploit software vulnerabilities in VMWare Workspace ONE Access
Horizon user can execute commands and scripts as a superuser (sudo)
script compresses files containing network interface configurations, users, passwords, masterkeys, hosts, and domains to a TAR archive, located in a VMWare Workspace ONE Access directory
attackers attempted to download MoneroOcean miner from GitHub from the associated IP
attackers used an associated IP address to run cat on a number of files in the listed directory
attackers attempted to download a JSP webshell from the listed URL
